records.jp: 星崎さん。いま、大丈夫ですか？<CR>実は、試してみたいことがあって
records.en_original: Are you available at the moment, Ao? There's something I've been wanting to try.
records.en_auxiliary: Are you available at the moment, Ao? There's something I've been wanting to try.
records.en: Hoshizaki-san, are you available now?<CR>There is something I would like to try.

records.jp: うん！　もちろん！
records.en_original: Sure! What's up?
records.en_auxiliary: Sure! What's up?
records.en: Yeah! Of course!

records.jp: ありがとうございます。<CR>では、少し付き合っていただけますか？
records.en_original: Thank you very much. Would you mind coming with me?
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you very much. Would you mind coming with me?
records.en: Thank you.<CR>Then would you accompany me for a little while?

records.jp: 詩さん、試したいことって？
records.en_original: What is it you wanted to try, Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: What is it you wanted to try, Uta?
records.en: What is it you wanted to try, Uta-san?

records.jp: え！？<CR>い、いきなりどうしたの！？
records.en_original: Huh?! Wh-what are you doing?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?! Wh-what are you doing?!
records.en: Huh!?<CR>Wh-what brought this on all of a sudden!?

records.jp: あ、すみません。<CR>驚かせてしまったようですね
records.en_original: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to startle you.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to startle you.
records.en: Ah, I am sorry.<CR>It seems I startled you.

records.jp: うん。いきなりだったから、ちょっと。<CR>もしかして、試したいことって、これ？
records.en_original: Yeah, that was really sudden. Is this what you wanted to try?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, that was really sudden. Is this what you wanted to try?
records.en: Yeah. It was sudden, so a little.<CR>Is this what you wanted to try?

records.jp: はい。実は先日読んだ本に、こうしたシーンが<CR>出てきたんです
records.en_original: Yes. There was a scene like this in the book I read the other day.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. There was a scene like this in the book I read the other day.
records.en: Yes. A scene like this appeared<CR>in the book I read the other day.

records.jp: （それって、この前図書室で見てたやつかな？）
records.en_original: (She must be talking about the book she saw at the library.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She must be talking about the book she saw at the library.)
records.en: (Could that be the one she was looking at in the library?)

records.jp: それで、同じように試してみたら、感情に何か<CR>変化があるかもしれないと思いまして……
records.en_original: I thought I'd try it and see if I felt anything.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought I'd try it and see if I felt anything.
records.en: So I thought that if I tried the same thing,<CR>there might be some change in my emotions...

records.jp: そ、そっか。<CR>……で、どんな感じ？
records.en_original: G-gotcha. Well...? Do you feel any different?
records.en_auxiliary: G-gotcha. Well...? Do you feel any different?
records.en: I-I see.<CR>...So, how does it feel?

records.jp: （恋愛もののシチュエーションを試すのは、<CR>何だかドキドキするけど……）
records.en_original: (I know this isn't real, but my heart's still racing...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I know this isn't real, but my heart's still racing...)
records.en: (Trying a situation from a romance story<CR>somehow makes my heart race, but...)

records.jp: （詩さんがこんな風にいろいろ試してみるのって、<CR>すごくいいと思うから、いっか）
records.en_original: (This is for Uta's own good, so I guess I don't mind.)
records.en_auxiliary: (This is for Uta's own good, so I guess I don't mind.)
records.en: (I think it is really good that Uta-san is trying<CR>all sorts of things like this, so I guess it is fine.)

records.jp: そう、ですね……
records.en_original: Let's see...
records.en_auxiliary: Let's see...
records.en: Let me see...

records.jp: 読んだ本に書かれていた感情とは違うと<CR>思いますが……
records.en_original: It seems to be a bit different from how it was described in the book, but...
records.en_auxiliary: It seems to be a bit different from how it was described in the book, but...
records.en: I believe it is different<CR>from the emotion described in the book, but...

records.jp: 手をこうして繋ぐというのは……<CR>想像したよりずっと、心地良いものなんですね
records.en_original: Holding hands like this is more comfortable than I thought.
records.en_auxiliary: Holding hands like this is more comfortable than I thought.
records.en: Holding hands like this...<CR>is far more pleasant than I imagined.

records.jp: 心地……良い？
records.en_original: Comfortable...?
records.en_auxiliary: Comfortable...?
records.en: Pleasant...?

records.jp: はい。星崎さんの体温と感触が伝わってきて
records.en_original: Yes, your hand is quite warm.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, your hand is quite warm.
records.en: Yes. I can feel your warmth and the sensation of your hand, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: （う。そんな風に言われると、こっちまで<CR>意識しちゃうんだけど）
records.en_original: (N-now that she mentions it, I guess she's right.)
records.en_auxiliary: (N-now that she mentions it, I guess she's right.)
records.en: (Ugh. When she puts it like that,<CR>it makes me conscious of it too.)

records.jp: （詩さんの手って、すべすべしてて柔らかくて……<CR>あれ？　なんか照れくさいような、嬉しいような？）
records.en_original: (Uta's hands are soft and smooth and... Huh? I feel kinda...happy?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Uta's hands are soft and smooth and... Huh? I feel kinda...happy?)
records.en: (Uta-san's hand is smooth and soft...<CR>Huh? Why do I feel embarrassed, yet kind of happy?)

records.jp: （な、なんかドキドキしてるんですけど！？<CR>こんなの、詩さんにバレたら困る！）
records.en_original: (Wh-why is my heart racing like this?! I hope Uta doesn't notice!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Wh-why is my heart racing like this?! I hope Uta doesn't notice!)
records.en: (M-my heart is racing for some reason!?<CR>It would be bad if Uta-san noticed this!)

records.jp: ……こうしていると、<CR>なんだか穏やかな気持ちになります
records.en_original: I feel very calm for some reason.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel very calm for some reason.
records.en: ...When we are like this,<CR>I somehow feel calm.

records.jp: そ、そっか……
records.en_original: O-oh, yeah?
records.en_auxiliary: O-oh, yeah?
records.en: I-I see...

records.jp: （ば、バレてなかった。よかったー！<CR>あ、でも……）
records.en_original: (Seems like she hasn't noticed. Phew! But hold on a sec...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Seems like she hasn't noticed. Phew! But hold on a sec...)
records.en: (S-she did not notice. Thank goodness!<CR>Ah, but...)

records.jp: んー。実は私、恋ってしたことないからさ。<CR>私も恋って感情、よく分からないんだよね
records.en_original: I've never really been in love, so I don't actually know what it feels like either.
records.en_auxiliary: I've never really been in love, so I don't actually know what it feels like either.
records.en: Hmm. Actually, I have never been in love.<CR>So I do not really understand the feeling either.

records.jp: お話の中にはよく出てくるけど、<CR>ふーん、そーなんだー、って感じ
records.en_original: People always talk about it in books and movies and stuff so I always just kind of accepted it.
records.en_auxiliary: People always talk about it in books and movies and stuff so I always just kind of accepted it.
records.en: It comes up in stories all the time,<CR>but I just think, "Oh, so that is what it is like."

records.jp: 私も……そう。<CR>だから、物語をうまく楽しめないんです
records.en_original: I think I feel the same... Perhaps that's why I can't seem to enjoy fiction.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I feel the same... Perhaps that's why I can't seem to enjoy fiction.
records.en: I am... the same.<CR>That is why I cannot properly enjoy stories.

records.jp: あ、私もキャラの気持ちが全然分からないと、<CR>もうわけ分かんなくて読めないー！
records.en_original: I know what you mean. A story's no fun if you can't understand how the character is feeling!
records.en_auxiliary: I know what you mean. A story's no fun if you can't understand how the character is feeling!
records.en: Ah, if I cannot understand a character's feelings at all,<CR>I get completely lost and cannot keep reading either!

records.jp: ふふ。星崎さんも、そうなんですか
records.en_original: Hehe, you too, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, you too, Ao?
records.en: Hehe. You feel that way too, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: （あの時の詩さんは、私も詩さんと同じように<CR>感じるんだって、嬉しそうにしてくれてた）
records.en_original: (Uta seemed really happy that I felt the same as her then.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Uta seemed really happy that I felt the same as her then.)
records.en: (Back then, Uta-san looked happy to hear<CR>that I felt the same way she did.)

records.jp: （私の感じてることが詩さんに伝わったら、<CR>あの時みたいに喜んでくれるかも）
records.en_original: (Maybe if I can convey how I'm feeling to her, she'll be able to feel that again.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Maybe if I can convey how I'm feeling to her, she'll be able to feel that again.)
records.en: (If what I am feeling reaches Uta-san,<CR>maybe she will be happy like she was then.)

records.jp: （あ、いやでも、一緒にドキドキしたら<CR>やっぱまずいよね！？）
records.en_original: (Hold on, if we both feel what I'm feeling right now...then what does that mean?!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hold on, if we both feel what I'm feeling right now...then what does that mean?!)
records.en: (Ah, no, but if our hearts raced together,<CR>that really would be a problem, right!?)

records.jp: えっと、詩さん。何か分かった？
records.en_original: So, uh, Uta. Have you discovered anything?
records.en_auxiliary: So, uh, Uta. Have you discovered anything?
records.en: Um, Uta-san. Did you learn anything?

records.jp: そうですね。<CR>やっぱりよく分かりません。ただ……
records.en_original: Hmm. Not particularly. However...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. Not particularly. However...
records.en: Let me see.<CR>I still do not really understand. However...

records.jp: 手を重ねた時の、星崎さんの様子が、<CR>なんだかとても楽しかったです
records.en_original: I very much enjoyed the look on your face when I held your hand.
records.en_auxiliary: I very much enjoyed the look on your face when I held your hand.
records.en: For some reason, watching you<CR>when our hands touched was very enjoyable, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: よかったら、また手を繋いでくださいね。<CR>では……
records.en_original: I'd love to do this again soon. Now if you'll excuse me...
records.en_auxiliary: I'd love to do this again soon. Now if you'll excuse me...
records.en: If you do not mind, please hold hands with me again.<CR>Well then...

records.jp: （はぁ……<CR>と、とりあえずほっとした……！）
records.en_original: (Phew... That was a close one!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Phew... That was a close one!)
records.en: (Phew...<CR>F-for now, what a relief...!)

records.jp: でも詩さん……あんな笑顔、見せてくれるように<CR>なったんだなぁ……
records.en_original: Still... Seems like Uta has started smiling a lot more.
records.en_auxiliary: Still... Seems like Uta has started smiling a lot more.
records.en: But Uta-san... she has started showing me<CR>smiles like that...

records.jp: <CLGR>詩<CLNR>のタレントに<CR>新たなタレントタイプが解放されました
records.en_original: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Uta's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en_auxiliary: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Uta's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en: A new Talent Type has been unlocked<CR>in <CLGR>Uta's<CLNR> Talents.
